purpose: Public source register and knowledge-distillation map for the BeeTrust synthetic commerce demonstrator.
boundary: Public pages support traceability and rule distillation only; current rules, broker advice, laboratory records and enterprise records must be revalidated before production use.
distillationMethod: Each source is mapped to a short finding, a versioned rule ID, a code branch and at least one self-test. No private Comvita SOP is claimed.

sources.publisher: New Zealand Ministry for Primary Industries
sources.finding: Exporters must work through product and destination requirements before release.

sources.publisher: New Zealand Ministry for Primary Industries
sources.finding: Honey export decisions depend on beekeeper, harvest, RMP and destination evidence.

sources.publisher: New Zealand Ministry for Primary Industries
sources.finding: Certificate and trade-assurance evidence is a release input for markets that require it.
HS classification and rates require current tariff evidence; the system stores a content hash when queried live.
Export declarations and supporting data must be prepared before clearance.
TSW output remains a broker-review draft in this demonstrator.

sources.publisher: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
sources.finding: Preferential treatment and destination rates require importer and agreement confirmation.
A public NZ honey enterprise can be used as a verifiable representative context; no private SOP or shipment data is inferred.
